name: Idomoo Ltd.
summary: Established in 2007 and headquartered in Ra'annana, Israel, Idomoo Ltd. operates a platform delivering personalized video as a service throughout Israel. The company's offerings encompass the creation of tailored, interactive video content, dynamic video advertisements, and customized graphic solutions. Idomoo serves a diverse range of industries, including banking, insurance, mortgages, pensions and retirement, gaming, agencies, advertising, telecommunications, utilities, travel and hospitality, retail and loyalty, education, and nonprofit organizations.
